# @uncle.f/free-agents

Free agent pack for [opencode](https://opencode.ai) — 2 powerful subagents that use free models, zero API cost.

## Included Agents

| Agent | Description | Model | Tools |
|-------|-------------|-------|-------|
| `scout` | Fast file search & info finder | deepseek-v4-flash-free | bash, read |
| `documenter` | Technical documentation writer | deepseek-v4-flash-free | bash, read, write, edit |

## Installation

Add to your `opencode.json` or `opencode.jsonc`:

```json
{
  "plugin": [
    "@uncle.f/free-agents"
  ]
}
```

That's it. Restart opencode and the agents are available via `@scout` and `@documenter`.

## Usage

### Scout — Fast File Search

```
@scout 找到所有包含 "TODO" 的文件
@scout 统计 src 目录下每个文件的代码行数
@scout 查找 package.json 里的所有依赖
```

### Documenter — Tech Docs

```
@documenter 为这个项目写一个 README.md
@documenter 为 src/api/auth.ts 写 API 文档
@documenter 生成项目架构设计文档
```

## Why Free Models?

Both free agents use `deepseek-v4-flash-free` — a fast, capable model that costs **zero tokens**. This makes them perfect for:
- Quick file searches without burning API quota
- Documentation drafts you'll refine manually
- Running alongside your main coding session
